chapter: Liberty Band, marriage and the Depression
title: The big storms and the fair job
summary: Allen asks who he played with during the big storm; Vincent recalls a storm that ruined a fair job and the two men struggle to date the storms.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
